notes.content:
Greetings Therians and Mistwalkers

First we would like to wish you a very fun year for 2024, may your skill raises and your coffers be full of loot.

We decided to do a joint announcement because we are the same team working on both games. Many of you wanted to know what is up with the team, especially about Mist Legacy because of the post we did in the fall. 

[b]For the short version: we will continue our work on both games as much as we can in 2024.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39950276/f543a3ee36c96678140fcd1b23d5c3ed5b18c625.png[/img]
[h3]Mist Legacy[/h3]
The change we did in the fall on monetization did have an impact, but what we still lack is volume. This means we have to ramp up the marketing. As you can expect, marketing is a time and cash-consuming task so it will impact the number of game updates we can do. But marketing, and you, need updates, so we will have a mix of marketing done and new content. So as for today, we are preparing the year with three updates: [b]March[/b], [b]September[/b] and [b]December[/b]. 

We expect that the updates for 2024 will focus on the main story of the game. Each one will unlock a new sector of the map and propose adventures that will have the possibility to unlock upgrades for companions and for your character with the Mistwalker reputation. Also, Sorka wrote to us and asked if she could come back to meet this cute hero she met on the Troll Plateau, we’ll see what we can do with that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39950276/641a1db9f2d5e7760f6de9cef52578de827752d6.png[/img]
[h3]Therian Saga[/h3]
For Therian Saga, we are very happy to keep this world alive and the way we handle the game is that we accumulate the revenues from the game and when we have enough we use it to create a game update for our players. Based on current income, we expect to have Falkarma working on the next update to be released in [b]May[/b] so he can finish the new region of Arkubel and possibly open a few other territories.

There is something that is a big worry for us about Therian Saga. We are stretching our luck by continuing to use the same technological engine (Silverlight) as we were 10 years ago. There is a possibility that we wake up one morning and that Microsoft decides to turn the switch off for this technology. And having our first game disappears from the online world, with all the memories linked to it, is just not something we want. In [b]June[/b], Virtys created a checkpoint for the future of this game, and we will explore our available options at that moment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39950276/3588e42061a8352d49ee09ff0dc4bd5f67a62c75.png[/img]
[h2]In Conclusion[/h2]
As always, this is our planning for the year and we cannot guarantee the plan will work as we thought it would, but it’s an honest plan and we think it could hold on for a year. We locked our schedule for the three Mist Legacy updates and the Therian Saga update. Let's say that if something big happens (yeah, we are also looking for other secret options) this should only mean more cool stuff is coming.

Thanks for playing with us!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39950276/6d4a179a545beef0f8fee9adab622abd8a5d0c82.png[/img]

notes.title: Therianor 1.35
notes.content:
Greetings, Therians!

First and foremost, I would like to express my gratitude to everyone who contributed to the creation of this Therian Saga update. Your support and input from the community have been invaluable in making this possible. The past few months have been a delightful journey, and returning to the game after this extended pause has proven to be a rejuvenating experience. The break from the game, combined with our return for version 1.35, has granted us a fresh perspective on the game.

As promised, in celebration of the 10th anniversary of Therian Saga, we are launching a special promotion. During this period, every player will be granted Premium status (with sleep anticipation benefits), and all four additional tasks will be activated for all players. This promotion will not have a predetermined end date.

In terms of content, the majority of the new additions will be situated in a previously unexplored region known as Therianor, located to the east of Hawkoria. Introducing new content also entails a set of challenges to unlock recipes and construct necessary structures.

Here's a summary of the changes in version 1.35 (for a more detailed version, please refer to our Discord):

[list]
[*]Introduction of a new region, Plain 60.
[*]Introduction of Wingu harvesting.
[*]Introduction of a new wood resource named Timoral.
[*]Addition of a new creature available for taming.
[*]Introduction of a new guild level along with a corresponding building.
[*]Introduction of a new colossal wood resource and two mineral clusters (Massilan and Hulbergor).
[*]Establishment of two new arenas designed for combat skills at levels 80 and 90.
[*]Introduction of a new boss, surpassing the strength of the Predatoris.
[/list]

This update was primarily designed for end-game players. Consequently, our next update is planned to cater to mid-game players. Our focus will be on expanding content around the Grimaldaz region, particularly the underground domain of Arkubel.

The specifics of when and how we will develop the next content remain uncertain. As a small team, we are committed to satisfying our player base to the best of our abilities. Our roadmap also alludes to an upcoming secret, which I'm unable to discuss at this time. However, rest assured that we are exploring various options for the game's long-term future.

Best regards,
Virtys

notes.title: 10 Years of Therian Saga and news about 1.35!
notes.content:
Greetings, Therians!

We are thrilled to announce that 10 years ago, on this very date, we released Therian Saga after several months of beta testing. Even after all these years, the game still boasts one of the most unique concepts in the industry. It isn't just your typical idle game; rather, it involves strategic planning of tasks and travels for your heroes, ensuring a rewarding experience even during short play sessions.

Keeping that in mind, we are pleased to inform you that starting with the next update, both the "sleep readiness" feature and the unlocking of all "Tasks" will be available to everyone. This significant change will make the game much more relevant in 2023, as the game's key features will no longer be hidden behind the monetization system.

Are there any new content updates for the game? Absolutely! In late July, we will be releasing version 1.35, which not only introduces a formidable new boss but also an entirely new region filled with resources and challenges designed for endgame players. We engaged in extensive discussions with the community and took note of the numerous new features they requested, which led us to allocate an additional month to develop this exciting new content.

In this update, you can expect to find (at least):
[list]
[*] A new region waiting to be unlocked.
[*] A means to acquire Hulbergor and Massilian.
[*] A giant tree for salancedar.
[*] An entirely new type of tree.
[*] Something extraordinary to tame.
[*] The complete life cycle of the wingu.
[*] A method to fulfill the missing Hunting achievement involving ayrann.
[*] Fresh festivities to advance to the next guild level.
[*] A new boss with three variations, offering a progressive challenge.
[*] New high-level arenas.
[/list]

We thank you for being with us throughout these years. It is an honor for us to keep the world of Therian Saga alive.

notes.title: Therian's Council 2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27582949/26df2c8b292aada3c981b7c60bf418a1b969b5ae.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the Council!

In January we had an infrastructure optimization to save on servers cost. This optimization is starting to give us results, so it is now time to plan on what we are going to do with Therian Saga this year.

The first thing we want to clear out is that you must not expect new engine features for the game (like the guild's war, mobile version, etc.) but we can build on our current system to add gameplay elements. The second thing is that we are running the game with a partial team so it will be very hard for us to create a new territory. We are likely to work on small updates that have a very focused gameplay goal and, if possible, have new regions being worked on as a background task.

What we are expecting for today council is that you give us hints on what would be key gameplay elements that you would like to see in the game. These elements can be described somewhat like this:

[list][*]We need a unit at X of skill Y because of this craft.
[*]We need to be able to harvest X (I know you'll say Wingu).
[*]The resource X is still useless we need something to do with it.
[*]The skill X has a lower cap than the other, we would need a new recipe at Y.
[*]Would be nice to have a challenge to build an X (mine) at difficulty Y.
[*]New monster with X of combat skill Y would help us.
[*]Between X and Y of the skill Z, it's far too hard to progress.
[*]Where is our flying ship???[/list]

For us, that would be a first step to know what is the most needed/wanted by you. We expect to have this council running for a few weeks before taking any decision, so everyone will have the chance to speak.

Thank you for your time, and now we are listening on our forum ( http://forum.theriansaga.com/viewtopic.php?f=61&t=8497 ) and here on Steam.

notes.title: 1.27 Przyjaciele: December 20
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27582949/bd16becda8319f772d2668ec01d8232fd871967f.jpg[/img]

First of all, we wish you an amazing end of 2017 and we thank you for supporting us in this fifth year of Virtys. We really hope you will enjoy your time off, if you have any,  and that you will spend time with your family and friends.

This is not a reason to forget Therian Saga. Especially since we will present, from December 20, a new update. This one will mark the long awaited arrival of the pets.

For this update, we decided to put several ideas that will be strengthened in the coming months. For example, the pets will be accessible, for the moment, only for baronnis, princanias and emperators. We are also adding a new system of replayable quests and new factions. These new features will also be improved during the next updates.

Here are the details:
   
[list][*]The new pet system is now in. For now it is only,  for the emperator, princania and baronnis.
[*]There will be a new system consisting of 6 re-playable quests.
There will be quests introducing three new faction reputations: the Letters Society, the Falconers and the Duchy. 
[*]Some quests already in play now give reputation points for different factions. A script will be put in place so that all the characters get the points they should have got. 
[*]The end of Liraine's quest that will reward you with a new lieutenant. 
[*]A new flight for the hipporiel to connect the Manticore’s mount to Grimaldaz. 
[*]The mobility potions given in the quest "A Spectral Touch" now gives bonuses. The object was empty. 
[*]Poisons won’t block heroes in a fight anymore.
[*]Fixed transport balms (now discoverable).
[*]Fixed a bug during guild transports.
[*]Other small corrections have been made. [/list]
To summarize, 2017 was a more stable year than the previous ones. It was especially marked by the Greenlight campaign and the official launch on the Steam platform. We are continually working on the future updates which will, as usual, contain crafts, resources and storyline quests.

That being said, have fun on the game! 

We will publish the exact schedule on December 19th.

Team Virtys
